title: Accessible Health and Well-Being Education
summary: Youth-led health literacy sessions, peer support, and referrals that remove barriers to quality care.
problem: Young people with disabilities face inaccessible health information, stigma, and limited youth-friendly services.
activities: Accessible health education workshops with captioning and sign language
Peer support circles and wellness coaching
Referral pathways to inclusive health facilities
howToJoin: Register through the Get Involved form
Partner as a health service provider

title: Economic Empowerment and Livelihood Skills
summary: Skills training, mentorship, and access to inclusive employment opportunities for youth with disabilities.
problem: Limited access to inclusive employment and capital keeps many youth with disabilities out of stable livelihoods.
activities: Private sector partnerships for inclusive hiring
